name: Release DMG

on:
  push:
    tags:
      # Final releases only (vX.Y.Z). Preview/candidate tags such as
      # v4.2.9-preview.1 must not start a macOS release build; they are
      # qualified by their own platform workflow (T47q).
      - "v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version (X.Y.Z); manual runs upload artifacts only'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-dmg-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-macos:
    name: Build Vox Agent DMG
    runs-on: macos-26
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VOX_TEAM_LOGIN_URL: https://api.osbornvox.com

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Resolve version and preserve existing release
        id: release
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: python scripts/prepare_dmg_release.py

      - name: Install engine build dependencies
        if: steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: python -m pip install . pyinstaller

      - name: Build DMG
        if: steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        run: bash ./scripts/build_voxagent_dmg.sh

      - name: Verify packaged version and cloud login origin
        if: steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PYVERIFY'
          import os, plistlib
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('build/voxagent-release/Vox Agent.app/Contents/Info.plist')
          with path.open('rb') as source:
              info = plistlib.load(source)
          if info.get('CFBundleShortVersionString') != os.environ['VERSION']:
              raise SystemExit('Packaged version differs from release version')
          if info.get('VoxTeamLoginURL') != os.environ['VOX_TEAM_LOGIN_URL']:
              raise SystemExit('Packaged cloud login origin is missing or incorrect')
          PYVERIFY

      - name: Reject legacy updater assets
        if: steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        run: python scripts/verify_update_assets.py --dist dist --version "$VERSION"

      - name: Upload artifact
        if: steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: vox-agent-release
          path: |
            dist/VoxAgent-v${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}-cloud.dmg
            dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
          if-no-files-found: error

      # Create-only: if another publisher wins the race, fail instead of replacing
      # their assets. Publishing/promoting the draft remains a separate acceptance step.
      - name: Create draft release
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'tag' && steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        run: >-
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          "dist/VoxAgent-v${VERSION}-cloud.dmg"
          "dist/SHA256SUMS.txt"
          --verify-tag --draft --prerelease --latest=false
          --title "Vox Agent $VERSION candidate" --generate-notes
